t: You're standing on Bentinck Street, a street in the City of Westminster. It's best known here as the birthplace of John Albery, who was born on this street in 1936. Wyndham John Albery, as he was formally named, grew up to be a British physical chemist and academic. He died in 2013. There's little more to say about the street itself from what I have, so take it in as an ordinary Westminster street with one scientist's start in life.
